Chapter - 10: Post Grant Opposition 
10.01 Post-grant Opposition 
1) Any person interested can give a notice of opposition against 
the grant of Patent in Form 7at the appropriate Office, any time 
after the grant but within one year from the date of publication 
of grant of patent. 
2) The opponent shall, along with the notice of opposition, send a 
written statement setting out the nature of opponent's interest, the 
facts upon which he bases his case and relief which he seeks and 
evidence, if any.
